verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP office offering online filing, search, and account services. A natural-language or conversational interface is a plausible capability for such a service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows operating the product through natural-language commands: the advanced search, MyCIPO login, and tailored IP-strategy guide generator are conventional web forms or tools, not natural-language control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
